required_external_inputs.name: MacOSX11.3.sdk.tar.xz
required_external_inputs.retrieval: Operator-supplied local SDK archive, registered with nix-store --add-fixed sha256; see PureDarwin pinned SDK derivation.

limitations: The host is macOS/Xcode beta. Source-build compatibility must be measured; this lock is an observed experiment environment, not a proven standalone target.
Recent Apple XNU ARM64 builds require a matching KDK; no matching KDK is installed. The public SDK alone does not supply all kernel inputs.
The upstream PureDarwin Nix baseline requires the distinct macOS11.3 SDK. Current SDK experiments have a different identity and cannot be passed off as the upstream input.
Docker/Nix guest-build inputs are pinned separately by the PureDarwin flake lock and virtualization tooling.
